text: Core courses Advanced Mathematics, College Physics, Computer fondation, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physics Chemistry, Solid Waste Control Engineering, Water Pollution Control Engineering, Environmental Monitoring Technique, Environmental Impact Assessment, Environmental Microbiology. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified technical personnel, working in government departments, planning units, environmental protection sectors, industrial and mining enterprises, research institutions, colleges and universities, or middle schools for various career pursuits in the fields of planning, design, construction, management, teaching and research. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering is granted.
